ABOUT THE DATA

Where these numbers come from.

Incidence is reported measles cases per million total population, from the WHO immunization data portal. MCV1 and MCV2 are first- and second-dose measles vaccine coverage (%) from the WHO/UNICEF Estimates of National Immunization Coverage (WUENIC).

Summaries. WHO data does not include case counts or population. Global and regional incidence therefore use WHO's own published estimates when no income, Gavi or development filter is applied. WHO publishes no regional coverage or filtered aggregates, so those values are the median reporting country, which is not an official estimate.

Classifications. Income group, development status and Gavi eligibility are current WHO/World Bank classifications applied to all years. Missing values are left blank (grey on the map) and break lines in charts; MCV2 before introduction is missing, not zero.

Geographic boundaries are from geo-countries / Natural Earth; no endorsement is implied.
